subject: Request: QuantumLytics POC - increased trial credits for high-context workload
messages:
From: Claire Park <claire@quantumlytics.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: larger trial credits for POC (QuantumLytics)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the warm onboarding call earlier. We kicked off a small internal pilot and the scope is larger than our original signup expectations — the POC will run end-to-end on a 1M-token context window variant for summarization + retrieval augmentation and our engineers estimate peak sustained TPM (tokens/min) around 450k for short bursts.

Given that, the default free credits on the self-serve plan won't cover the first two weeks of testing. Can Redwood temporarily increase our initial free credit allocation or provide a short-term trial top-up (30 days) to cover:

- heavy context-window runs (1M token models)
- throughput tests and caching/batching tuning
- a small set of production-simulated traffic to validate cost & latency

I've attached the POC spec and a token-estimate workbook. Our ask: a 30-day top-up sufficient to cover ~8M tokens of generation + embedding calls (~$8k equivalent) or guidance on an alternate approach (reserved burst quota) if that's preferable.

Happy to jump on a quick call with Aditya and your ops team to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Claire Park
Head of AI Integrations
QuantumLytics

Attachments: QuantumLytics_POC_Specs.pdf (18 pages), token_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Monica / Soojin — quick summary and recommendation.

Summary:
- QuantumLytics wants a 30-day trial top-up to handle a 1M-context POC.
- They estimate ~8M tokens consumed in first 30 days (generation + embeddings), with peaks ~450k TPM.
- They are evaluating latency and cost; this is a potential $/mo expansion if POC is successful.

Numbers (rough):
- Standard signup credits: $1,000 equivalent (~0.9M tokens on smaller models).
- Requested coverage: ~$8,000 equivalent to be safe for both generation and embeddings during tuning.

Recommendation:
- Approve a time-limited top-up equal to $8,000 credit with the following guardrails:
  1) 30-day expiration from issuance
  2) hard TPM cap of 500k (automatic throttling)
  3) billing tag and HubSpot deal DL-78341-QL must be associated for audit
  4) require Claire to share a quick metrics snapshot at day 14 (tokens used, latency, candidate model)

If approved, Soojin can issue a voucher code or apply a promo to their self-serve account.

Ping if you want me to draft the promo text for the portal.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
